key_facts: A "joint work" is a work prepared by two or more authors with the intention that their contributions be merged into inseparable or interdependent parts of a unitary whole.

forbidden_claims.claim: A work of visual art may exist in an edition of up to 500 numbered copies without losing protection.
An unpublished work is automatically barred from a fair use defense under Section 107.
Libraries may use the last-20-years exemption even while a work is still sold commercially at an affordable price.

notes: Section 107 explicitly says unpublished status does NOT bar fair use -- a dropped-negation trap. Four unrelated code sections concatenated.
